name: otp-input
title: OTP Input
description: One-time-password / verification-code input: a row of single-character cells that auto-advance on entry, accept clipboard paste (spread across cells), and support arrow/backspace/Home/End navigation. 4 or 6 cells; numeric or alphanumeric; optional inline separator (length 6). Controlled-first value + onValueChange + onComplete, with label/hint/error field chrome and aria-invalid/aria-describedby wiring.
